description: Product KPIs for LukiFitti: signups, onboarding funnel, activation, retention cohorts and engagement, queried read-only from the app's PostgreSQL database. 'Active' means at least one completed workout. Panels return aggregates only, no PII.

panels.title: Total users
panels.description: All registered accounts, independent of the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Users" FROM "User"

panels.title: New signups
panels.description: Accounts created within the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Signups" FROM "User" WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt")

panels.title: Email verified
panels.description: Share of signups in the time range that confirmed their email.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE "emailVerified") / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "Verified" FROM "User" WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt")

panels.title: Activation rate (7d)
panels.description: Signups in range that completed a workout within 7 days of registering. Only signups at least 7 days old are counted, so recent ones don't drag it down.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "WorkoutSession" s WHERE s."userId" = u.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' AND s."completedAt" >= u."createdAt" AND s."completedAt" < u."createdAt" + interval '7 days')) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "Activated" FROM "User" u WHERE $__timeFilter(u."createdAt") AND u."createdAt" <= timezone('utc', now()) - interval '7 days'

panels.title: Weekly active users
panels.description: Distinct users with at least one completed workout in the last 7 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT "userId") AS "WAU" FROM "WorkoutSession" WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND "completedAt" >= timezone('utc', now()) - interval '7 days'

panels.title: Monthly active users
panels.description: Distinct users with at least one completed workout in the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT "userId") AS "MAU" FROM "WorkoutSession" WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND "completedAt" >= timezone('utc', now()) - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Stickiness (DAU / MAU)
panels.description: Average daily active users over the last 30 days divided by MAU. For a fitness app ~3 workouts/week corresponds to ~40%.

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS ( SELECT date_trunc('day', "completedAt") AS day, count(DISTINCT "userId") AS n FROM "WorkoutSession" WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND "completedAt" >= timezone('utc', now()) - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1) SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT coalesce(sum(n), 0) FROM d) / 30.0 / NULLIF((SELECT count(DISTINCT "userId") FROM "WorkoutSession" WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND "completedAt" >= timezone('utc', now()) - interval '30 days'), 0), 1) AS "Stickiness"

panels.title: Median time to 1st workout
panels.description: Median time from registration to the first completed workout, for signups in range that have completed one.

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM f.first_done - u."createdAt")) AS "Median" FROM "User" u JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(s."completedAt") AS first_done FROM "WorkoutSession" s WHERE s."userId" = u.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' AND s."completedAt" >= u."createdAt") f ON f.first_done IS NOT NULL WHERE $__timeFilter(u."createdAt")

panels.title: Stuck unverified (> 48h)
panels.description: Signups in range that still haven't verified their email after 48 hours. A spike usually means confirmation emails are not arriving.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Users" FROM "User" WHERE NOT "emailVerified" AND "createdAt" < timezone('utc', now()) - interval '48 hours' AND $__timeFilter("createdAt")

panels.title: Confirmation emails failed
panels.description: Account confirmation emails that permanently failed within the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Failed" FROM "Email" e JOIN "EmailTemplate" t ON t.id = e."emailTemplateId" WHERE t.type = 'ACCOUNT_CONFIRMATION' AND e.status = 'FAILED' AND $__timeFilter(e."createdAt")

panels.title: Workouts completed
panels.description: Completed workout sessions within the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Workouts" FROM "WorkoutSession" WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND $__timeFilter("completedAt")

panels.title: At-risk users (14d idle)
panels.description: Users who trained at some point in the last 90 days but not in the last 14 days. Good target for a win-back nudge.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Users" FROM ( SELECT "userId", max("completedAt") AS last_done FROM "WorkoutSession" WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY 1) t WHERE last_done < timezone('utc', now()) - interval '14 days' AND last_done >= timezone('utc', now()) - interval '90 days'

panels.title: Funnel: users per step
panels.description: How many of the users who signed up in the selected range reached each onboarding step. Workouts only count if they happened after signup.

targets.rawSql: WITH u AS ( SELECT id, "createdAt", "emailVerified" FROM "User" WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt")), s AS ( SELECT s."userId", count(*) AS started, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'COMPLETED') AS done, count(DISTINCT date_trunc('day', s."completedAt")) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'COMPLETED') AS days FROM "WorkoutSession" s JOIN u ON u.id = s."userId" WHERE s."startedAt" >= u."createdAt" GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE true) AS "1. Signed up", count(*) FILTER (WHERE u."emailVerified") AS "2. Verified email", count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.started >= 1) AS "3. Started a workout", count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.done >= 1) AS "4. Completed 1st workout", count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.days >= 2) AS "5. Came back another day", count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.done >= 3) AS "6. Completed 3+ workouts" FROM u LEFT JOIN s ON s."userId" = u.id

panels.title: Funnel: conversion from signup
panels.description: Same funnel expressed as % of signups. The biggest drop between two neighbouring bars is the onboarding step to work on first.

targets.rawSql: WITH u AS ( SELECT id, "createdAt", "emailVerified" FROM "User" WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt")), s AS ( SELECT s."userId", count(*) AS started, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'COMPLETED') AS done, count(DISTINCT date_trunc('day', s."completedAt")) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'COMPLETED') AS days FROM "WorkoutSession" s JOIN u ON u.id = s."userId" WHERE s."startedAt" >= u."createdAt" GROUP BY 1) SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE true) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "1. Signed up", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE u."emailVerified") / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "2. Verified email", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.started >= 1) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "3. Started a workout", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.done >= 1) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "4. Completed 1st workout", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.days >= 2) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "5. Came back another day", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.done >= 3) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "6. Completed 3+ workouts" FROM u LEFT JOIN s ON s."userId" = u.id

panels.title: Time from signup to 1st workout
panels.description: Distribution of how long activated users took to complete their first workout.

targets.rawSql: WITH f AS ( SELECT extract(epoch FROM min(s."completedAt") - u."createdAt") / 3600 AS h FROM "User" u JOIN "WorkoutSession" s ON s."userId" = u.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' AND s."completedAt" >= u."createdAt" WHERE $__timeFilter(u."createdAt") GROUP BY u.id), b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN h < 1 THEN 0 WHEN h < 24 THEN 1 WHEN h < 72 THEN 2 WHEN h < 168 THEN 3 WHEN h < 672 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS ord FROM f) SELECT (ARRAY['< 1 hour', '1-24 hours', '1-3 days', '3-7 days', '1-4 weeks', '> 4 weeks'])[ord + 1] AS "Time to first workout", count(*) AS "Users" FROM b GROUP BY ord ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Signups vs. activated within 7 days
panels.description: Per signup bucket: how many accounts were created and how many of them completed a workout within their first 7 days. The last 7 days are still maturing.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(u."createdAt", $bucket, 0), count(*) AS "Signups", count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "WorkoutSession" s WHERE s."userId" = u.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' AND s."completedAt" >= u."createdAt" AND s."completedAt" < u."createdAt" + interval '7 days')) AS "Activated within 7 days" FROM "User" u WHERE $__timeFilter(u."createdAt") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Total users
panels.description: Cumulative registered accounts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, (SELECT count(*) FROM "User" WHERE "createdAt" < $__timeFrom()) + sum(n) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS "Total users" FROM (SELECT $__timeGroup("createdAt", $bucket) AS time, count(*) AS n FROM "User" WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt") GROUP BY 1) t ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Distinct users with a completed workout per bucket (DAU at 1d, WAU at 1w).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("completedAt", $bucket, 0), count(DISTINCT "userId") AS "Active users" FROM "WorkoutSession" WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND $__timeFilter("completedAt") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly signup cohorts: % who completed a workout in week N
panels.description: Each row is a signup week. 'Week N' = share of that cohort who completed at least one workout N weeks after registering (week 0 = first 7 days). Cells stay empty until the whole cohort has had time to reach that week.

targets.rawSql: WITH cohort AS ( SELECT id, "createdAt", date_trunc('week', "createdAt") AS week FROM "User" WHERE $__timeFilter("createdAt")), act AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.id, floor(extract(epoch FROM s."completedAt" - c."createdAt") / 604800)::int AS wk FROM cohort c JOIN "WorkoutSession" s ON s."userId" = c.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' AND s."completedAt" >= c."createdAt") SELECT to_char(c.week, 'IYYY-"W"IW') AS "Cohort", count(DISTINCT c.id) AS "Signups", round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.id) / count(DISTINCT c.id), 1) AS "Ever trained", CASE WHEN c.week + interval '14 days' <= timezone('utc', now()) THEN round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.wk = 0) / count(DISTINCT c.id), 1) END AS "Week 0" , CASE WHEN c.week + interval '21 days' <= timezone('utc', now()) THEN round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.wk = 1) / count(DISTINCT c.id), 1) END AS "Week 1" , CASE WHEN c.week + interval '28 days' <= timezone('utc', now()) THEN round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.wk = 2) / count(DISTINCT c.id), 1) END AS "Week 2" , CASE WHEN c.week + interval '42 days' <= timezone('utc', now()) THEN round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.wk = 4) / count(DISTINCT c.id), 1) END AS "Week 4" , CASE WHEN c.week + interval '70 days' <= timezone('utc', now()) THEN round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.wk = 8) / count(DISTINCT c.id), 1) END AS "Week 8" FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN act a ON a.id = c.id GROUP BY c.week ORDER BY c.week DESC

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("completedAt", $bucket, 0), count(*) FILTER (WHERE "sourceDevice" = 'IPHONE') AS "iPhone", count(*) FILTER (WHERE "sourceDevice" = 'APPLE_WATCH') AS "Apple Watch", count(*) FILTER (WHERE "sourceDevice" = 'WEB') AS "Web" FROM "WorkoutSession" WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND $__timeFilter("completedAt") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Workout completion rate
panels.description: Completed / (completed + abandoned) sessions by start time. Drops point to friction during a workout.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startedAt", $bucket), round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED', 'ABANDONED')), 0), 1) AS "Completion rate" FROM "WorkoutSession" WHERE $__timeFilter("startedAt") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE "sourceDevice" = 'IPHONE') AS "iPhone", count(*) FILTER (WHERE "sourceDevice" = 'APPLE_WATCH') AS "Apple Watch", count(*) FILTER (WHERE "sourceDevice" = 'WEB') AS "Web" FROM "WorkoutSession" WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND $__timeFilter("completedAt")

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE "sessionType" = 'STRENGTH') AS "Strength", count(*) FILTER (WHERE "sessionType" = 'STRETCHING') AS "Stretching", count(*) FILTER (WHERE "sessionType" = 'MIXED') AS "Mixed" FROM "WorkoutSession" WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND $__timeFilter("completedAt")

panels.title: Feature adoption (monthly active users)
panels.description: Share of the last 30 days' active users who have ever used each feature. Starter templates seeded at signup don't count as 'own'.

targets.rawSql: WITH mau AS ( SELECT DISTINCT "userId" AS id FROM "WorkoutSession" WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND "completedAt" >= timezone('utc', now()) - interval '30 days'), f AS ( SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "WorkoutSession" s WHERE s."userId" = m.id AND s."sourceDevice" = 'APPLE_WATCH') AS watch, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "WorkoutSession" s WHERE s."userId" = m.id AND s."healthKitWorkoutUuid" IS NOT NULL) AS health, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "WorkoutSession" s WHERE s."userId" = m.id AND s."sessionType" = 'STRETCHING') AS stretch, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "WorkoutTemplate" t WHERE t."userId" = m.id AND t."systemKey" IS NULL) AS own_tpl, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Exercise" e WHERE e."userId" = m.id) AS custom_ex, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "UserPreferences" p WHERE p."userId" = m.id AND p."updatedAt" > p."createdAt" + interval '1 minute') AS prefs FROM mau m) SELECT round(100 * avg(own_tpl::int), 1) AS "Own / edited template", round(100 * avg(prefs::int), 1) AS "Changed settings", round(100 * avg(health::int), 1) AS "Apple Health sync", round(100 * avg(watch::int), 1) AS "Apple Watch", round(100 * avg(stretch::int), 1) AS "Stretching", round(100 * avg(custom_ex::int), 1) AS "Custom exercise" FROM f

panels.title: Lifetime completed workouts per user
panels.description: All users bucketed by how many workouts they have completed.

targets.rawSql: WITH n AS ( SELECT u.id, count(s.id) AS n FROM "User" u LEFT JOIN "WorkoutSession" s ON s."userId" = u.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY u.id), b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN n = 0 THEN 0 WHEN n = 1 THEN 1 WHEN n < 5 THEN 2 WHEN n < 10 THEN 3 WHEN n < 25 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS ord FROM n) SELECT (ARRAY['0', '1', '2-4', '5-9', '10-24', '25+'])[ord + 1] AS "Completed workouts", count(*) AS "Users" FROM b GROUP BY ord ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Hit weekly goal (last full week)
panels.description: Of users who trained last ISO week (Mon-Sun), the share that reached their personal weekly session goal.

targets.rawSql: WITH wk AS ( SELECT date_trunc('week', timezone('utc', now())) - interval '7 days' AS start), c AS ( SELECT s."userId", count(*) AS n FROM "WorkoutSession" s, wk WHERE s.status = 'COMPLETED' AND s."completedAt" >= wk.start AND s."completedAt" < wk.start + interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1) SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.n >= coalesce(p."weeklyGoalSessions", 4)) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "Hit goal" FROM c LEFT JOIN "UserPreferences" p ON p."userId" = c."userId"

title: LukiFitti KPIs
